subject.title: embedded_run bootstrap-context blocks event loop for 14-22 seconds

question: Should maintainers continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89040 as the canonical repair path for this issue, or ask for a narrower replacement once its mergeability and live-liveness proof gaps are resolved?
rationale: The issue is valid and already has an open closing PR, but that PR is not merged and its proof is focused rather than a full embedded_run/channel keepalive scenario, so maintainer intent is needed for the adoption path.

options.title: Refresh and review linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR as the canonical repair if it can be rebased and proven against a real embedded_run/channel liveness scenario.

options.title: Request a narrower replacement
options.body: Ask for a smaller branch if maintainers want the same async/yielding behavior with less touched surface.

options.title: Hold for broader scheduling design
options.body: Keep this issue open without landing the current PR if maintainers decide bootstrap-context stalls require a larger worker-thread or runtime scheduling design.

recommendation.title: Refresh and review linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR as the canonical repair if it can be rebased and proven against a real embedded_run/channel liveness scenario.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for the bootstrap and internal-hook architecture that would guide whether to adopt or reshape the linked repair.
